objective: Make frozen CPVS reference acquisition fail closed if the checksum-verified archive does not contain all expected publisher CSV members.
previous_knowledge_consumed: The immutable Zenodo 5764899 archive has a pinned MD5 and SHA-256 in the existing acquisition manifest.
The latest workflow artifact manifest listed 1st_layer.csv, 2nd_layer.csv, and SIMBAD_ZTF_crossmatch.csv, while the source definition had required_members empty.
The published membership comparison remains blocked; archive integrity alone is not object-level membership validation.

baseline.description: The CPVS frozen-reference source checked the archive hash but accepted any ZIP member layout because required_members was empty.

change.scope: Require the three previously observed publisher archive member basenames and add regression tests for the declared contract and missing-member detection. No membership count, derivation predicate, model, or scientific acceptance criterion is changed.
change.rationale: A matching checksum and archive listing should not silently be treated as sufficient if expected publisher files disappear or the archive layout changes.

correctness.before: The CPVS archive source contract declared no required member names; the lifecycle validator accepted the record only after its metric schema is corrected.
correctness.after: The source contract requires 1st_layer.csv, 2nd_layer.csv, and SIMBAD_ZTF_crossmatch.csv; current-head CI and archive-contract tests remain pending.

reproducibility.before: The latest source-backed run derived 741,787 candidates against an expected 730,184 reference members, but independent object-level comparison did not complete.
reproducibility.after: Unchanged: this patch only hardens archive member validation; the 11,603 run-specific excess remains unexplained.

measurement.trade_off: Fail earlier if a published archive's expected file layout changes; require explicit review before accepting a new archive contract.

evidence: Regression tests added; awaiting current-head CI and source-backed workflow verification.
validation.blocker: Current-head CI must pass. The published 730,184 SourceID set has not been extracted and compared object-by-object, and the 11,603 candidate excess remains unexplained.

root_causes: The source definition declared no required members for the CPVS archive, so an unexpected/incomplete member layout could pass acquisition contract validation. This is a provenance-contract gap, not the established cause of the 11,603 membership discrepancy.

findings: Archive checksum verification and member/schema validation are separate checks.
Passing archive acquisition does not prove membership equality or reproduce publisher selection rules.

open_blockers: The published 730,184 SourceID set has not been extracted and compared object-by-object.
The root cause of the 11,603 run-specific candidate excess remains unknown.

knowledge_carried_forward: Keep CPVS membership discrepancy explicitly blocked until full IDs, source provenance, and FP/FN are independently computed.
Do not infer canonical membership from row count alone.
Do not weaken scientific acceptance criteria.
